profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Independent Pyrenean guardians, serene Newfoundlands and even-tempered Hovawarts show the varied characters of mountain-type dogs. Their work ranges from protecting flocks to hauling loads and helping in the water. Hovawarts also use their noses in tracking and rescue, while Pyrenean dogs developed initiative when guarding without constant direction.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: From independent Pyrenean guardians to serene Newfoundlands, mountain-type dogs span very different working roles.
